title: Multilingual Coarse Political Stance Classification of Media. The Editorial Line of a ChatGPT and Bard Newspaper

bias_targets.methodology: Training a multilingual XLM-RoBERTa classifier on authentic news articles annotated with Left and Right political stances via distant supervision (using media bias rating sites), and then applying this classifier to evaluate the political leaning of 101 newspaper-like articles generated by ChatGPT and Bard across four languages and different time periods.
